svg.text: Her decks from the 1812 inboard profile and deck plans: spaces, openings, fittings, guns, ways
Dark: guns; brown: hatches, ladderways, scuttles; pale blue: skylight; buff: fittings. Lines: bulkheads. Blue: ladders, orange: doors, green: open floor; violet: stations.
Berth deck (1.6 m under the beams)
Hold and platforms (about 1.2 m under the beams)
